package student

import (
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
)

func TestSanitizeWorkspaceFilesForAIExcludesSecretFilesAndRedactsAssignments(t *testing.T) {
	files := sanitizeWorkspaceFilesForAI([]domain.WorkspaceFile{
		{Path: "index.html", Content: "<h1>Safe</h1>"},
		{Path: ".env.local", Content: "API_KEY=must-not-leak"},
		{Path: "config/app.go", Content: "password := \"must-not-leak\"\nname := \"shop\""},
		{Path: "certs/server.pem", Content: "private"},
	})
	if len(files) != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("expected only review-safe files, got %#v", files)
	}
	if files[0].Path != "index.html" || files[0].Content != "<h1>Safe</h1>" {
		t.Fatalf("expected safe source to remain intact, got %#v", files[0])
	}
	if strings.Contains(files[1].Content, "must-not-leak") || !strings.Contains(files[1].Content, "[REDACTED SECRET LINE]") {
		t.Fatalf("expected inline credential assignment to be redacted, got %#v", files[1])
	}
}
